#### Clase `StapledByteStream` (Línea 29)
- **Docstring:** _Combines two byte streams into a single, bidirectional byte stream.

providing the values in case of a conflict.

#### Clase `MultiListener` (Línea 101)
- **Docstring:** _Combines multiple listeners into one, serving connections from all of them at once.

Any MultiListeners in the given collection of listeners will have their listeners
moved into this one.

Extra attributes are provided from each listener, with each successive listener
overriding any conflicting attributes from the previous one.

:param listeners: listeners to serve
:type listeners: Sequence[Listener[T_Stream]]_
